objective: Shorten occupancy and increase usable profitable opportunities while preserving after-cost robustness. Each round is training-selected only; Direct-USDC/full-window validation may reject but never steer the next round.

round_families.1: broad max-hold 24/48/72/120/168 plus bounded ATR stop/trail overlays
round_families.2: short max-hold 6/12/18/24/36/48 with finer ATR stop/trail
round_families.3: local CMO refinement around the current training champion plus max-hold
round_families.4: slope 0/24/72 refinement around the current training champion plus max-hold
round_families.5: combined stop+trail refinement around the current training champion
round_families.6: final short-occupancy consolidation around current training champion
